PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

specialising in Payments, Core Banking, and large-scale technology transformation programs. Proven track

engagement at senior levels. Adept at managing SIT, UAT, regression, and DR testing cycles, driving automation 
initiatives, and overseeing cloud-based data transformation projects across US, Asia, LATAM, and CEEMEA 
regions.
